meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自动实验把模型或流程的评分逐步顶高
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为模型或流程的分数头疼,想用自动实验挑出更稳妥的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run experiments to push model or pipeline scores steadily higher
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automatic experiments to improve a model or pipeline and avoid overfitting.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会当协调者，围绕一个有评测器的产物（代码、训练配方、数据流程、提示词等）反复做实验与评估，把研究状态记在假设树上，只把通过独立测试评测器的改动并进最佳版本。
howto.when: 当你要求反复优化某个产物、跑很多轮实验，或担心过拟合开发集时触发，即使你从没提过 “Arbor”。若只需一次性修复或无评测器，则不适用。

say.text: 帮我提高这个搜索 harness 的准确率，跑多轮实验但别过拟合
say.note: 它会先和你确认目标、开发评测器与测试评测器

say.text: 把我模型的 eval 分数刷上去，同时守住 held-out 测试集
say.note: 每轮实验在独立 git worktree 里执行

say.text: 对这些改进思路做分支探索，只留下通过测试门槛的那个
say.note: 被淘汰的分支会记录原因，作为后续约束

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as the coordinator and runs repeated experiment-and-evaluate cycles on an artifact, keeping research state in a hypothesis tree and merging only changes that pass a held-out test evaluator.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to iteratively improve an artifact over many experiments, or worry about overfitting the dev set, even if you never say "Arbor".

say_en.text: Run many experiment rounds to raise my harness's accuracy, without overfitting
say_en.note: It first pins down the objective and dev/test evaluators

say_en.text: Get my model's eval score up while keeping the held-out test set honest
say_en.note: Each round runs in an isolated git worktree

say_en.text: Branch out over competing ideas and keep only the one that passes the test gate
say_en.note: Pruned branches record why, as later constraints
